name: Block Usage Report
description: Exposes a report showing which blocks are enabled and where they are placed.
project_description: Block Usage Report adds a single read-only admin report at /admin/reports/block-usage that lists which blocks are placed in the site's default theme, whether each is enabled or disabled, and which region it occupies. Beyond the region-placed blocks that core's block layout page already shows, it reflects placements that no core screen summarises: blocks embedded in content via the block_field module, blocks in Layout Builder bundle-default layout templates, blocks in per-entity overridden Layout Builder layouts, custom-block associations made through fixed_block_content, and custom blocks that are unplaced anywhere. Each detected placement links to the relevant operations. Integrations with block_field, layout_builder and fixed_block_content are auto-detected and optional; the module has no hard dependencies beyond core.
